旧密码会保留在这个条目的历史中，可以随时恢复。如果你没有在这个网站上修改密码，请: The old password stays in this item's history and can be restored anytime. If you didn't change your password on this website, choose Don't Update.

明文文件不受 Keevo 保护：同步盘、备份与邮件附件都可能把它复制到别处。导入: Keevo can't protect a plaintext file: sync folders, backups, and email attachments can copy it elsewhere. Delete it as soon as you've imported it.
明文文件中的密码，任何拿到文件的人都能读取。: Anyone who gets the file can read the passwords in it.
显示锁定状态，提供快速访问、生成密码与立即锁定。关闭窗口后 Keevo 继续在菜: Shows whether Keevo is locked and offers Quick Access, Generate Password, and Lock Now. Keevo keeps running in the menu bar after you close its window.
暂不支持 {} 私钥：目前 SSH Agent 只支持 Ed25519。ECDS: {} private keys aren't supported yet: the SSH agent currently supports Ed25519 only. ECDSA and RSA arrive once their cryptography libraries pass supply-chain review. Run ssh-keygen -t ed25519 in Terminal to create an Ed25519 key, or generate one here.
暂不支持这种加密方式{}。请在终端运行 ssh-keygen -p -Z aes: This encryption{} isn't supported yet. Run ssh-keygen -p -Z aes256-ctr -f <key file> in Terminal to switch to aes256-ctr, then import it.
更改后重新打开 Keevo 生效。: Takes effect the next time you open Keevo.
最常见的 10 个密码之一: One of the 10 most common passwords
最常见的 100 个密码之一: One of the 100 most common passwords
最近 20 个版本，以及 90 天内（按 Keevo 的运行时间计）的全部版本会: The last 20 versions, and every version from the past 90 days (counting the time Keevo has been running), keep their content; older ones keep only the revision record.
有撤销没能写入数据库，重启 Keevo 后可能失效。下次解锁时会自动重试。: A revocation couldn't be written to the database and may be lost if Keevo restarts. Keevo retries the next time you unlock.
每 {} 天至少输入一次主密码: Enter the master password at least once every {} days

没有找到一次性密码的二维码: No one-time password QR code found
没有检查。可以在安全中心开启泄露检查。: Not checked. You can turn on breach checks in the Security Center.
点击 + 添加第一个登录，或从其他密码管理器导入。: Click + to add your first login, or import from another password manager.
现在不能使用 Touch ID，请输入主密码。: Touch ID can't be used right now. Enter your master password.
生成新的 Ed25519 密钥（也可以之后导入现有私钥）: Generate a new Ed25519 key (you can also import an existing key later)
生成新的 Ed25519 密钥，并在服务器上替换旧的公钥。: Generate a new Ed25519 key and replace the old public key on your servers.
生成新的密钥替换现在的私钥？: Replace the current private key with a new one?
用你设置的导出密码加密，可以在另一台 Mac 或另一个账户中导入: Encrypted with an export password you set; import it on another Mac or into another account

用生成器生成随机密码或口令短语。修改后这里自动更新。: Use the generator for a random password or passphrase. This list updates after you change it.

看起来不像电子邮件地址: This doesn't look like an email address
睡眠、锁定屏幕、启动屏幕保护程序或切换用户时会立即锁定。: Keevo also locks right away on sleep, screen lock, screen saver, or user switch.
确认网站是否支持 https://，支持时更新条目中的网址。: Check whether the site supports https://, and if so update the item's URL.
秘密的值默认隐藏，复制后自动清除: Secret values are hidden by default and cleared after copying
移入回收站的条目会出现在这里，可以恢复。: Items you delete appear here and can be restored.
第 3 天、第 7 天，之后每月一次。只在开启了 Touch ID 时提醒。: On day 3, day 7, then monthly. Only when Touch ID is on.
粘贴私钥文件的内容，或从文件读取。支持 OpenSSH 格式（可以有口令保护）与: Paste the private key or read it from a file. OpenSSH format (with or without a passphrase) and Ed25519 PKCS#8 PEM are supported. After import, the vault keeps the key encrypted and you can delete the original file.
约 {} 比特熵 · 4 个随机单词: About {} bits of entropy · 4 random words
自动锁定：{}、睡眠或锁屏时: Locks automatically after {}, on sleep, or when the screen locks
至少 {} 个字符；推荐使用生成的口令短语。: At least {} characters; a generated passphrase is recommended.
见应急包，以 K1- 开头: On your Emergency Kit, starts with K1-
解锁后继续这次搜索。: Your search continues after you unlock.
解除后，这个扩展立即断开，不能再取用任何密码。请先确认是你本人。: The extension disconnects immediately and can no longer use any passwords. First confirm it's you.
让 ssh 与 git 使用保险库中的密钥: Let ssh and git use keys from your vault

Run the packaged Keevo.app (scripts/package-macos.sh) to use the command-line tool and SSH agent.

请先确认是你本人。应急包中有账户密钥。: First confirm it's you. The Emergency Kit contains your Secret Key.

账户密钥中没有字母 I、L、O、U：看起来像 0 或 1 的字符都是数字。: The Secret Key has no letters I, L, O, or U: anything that looks like 0 or 1 is a digit.

还没有在 Agent 中开启的 SSH 密钥。先在「设置 → 开发者 → SSH: No SSH key is enabled in the agent yet. First choose how a key is used in Settings → Developer → SSH Keys.
还没有填写任何字段。点「编辑」添加。: No fields yet. Click Edit to add some.
还没有安装命令行工具：先在「设置 → 开发者 → 命令行工具」中安装，签名程序: The command-line tool isn't installed. Install it in Settings → Developer → Command-Line Tool; the keevo-ssh-sign signer comes with it.
还没有私钥：生成新的密钥或导入现有私钥。: No private key yet: generate a new key or import an existing one.
这不是 Keevo 备份文件，或者文件已损坏。: This isn't a Keevo backup, or the file is damaged.
这个保险库的解锁参数异常地高，可能被篡改过。为安全起见，Keevo 没有自动解锁: This vault's unlock parameters are unusually high and may have been tampered with. To be safe, Keevo didn't unlock automatically.
这个保险库要求的密钥派生强度远高于 Keevo 的默认值。: This vault asks for key derivation far stronger than the Keevo default.
这个文件不是所选来源的导出文件。请确认来源，或重新导出。: This file isn't an export from the selected source. Check the source, or export again.
这个文件有 {}，超过了单个附件 50 MB 的上限。: This file is {}, over the 50 MB limit for a single attachment.
这个条目中有多个私钥字段，Agent 不知道用哪一个。请删除多余的。: This item has several private key fields, so the agent can't tell which to use. Remove the extra ones.
这个条目合并其他设备的内容后超出了上限，只能查看。可以把它重建为一个新条目后继续: After merging changes from other devices, this item exceeds the limits and is read-only. Rebuild it as a new item to keep editing.
这个条目合并其他设备的内容后过大，无法保存。请先处理冲突或删除部分字段。: After merging changes from other devices, this item is too large to save. Resolve conflicts or remove some fields first.
这个条目在另一台设备上被删除，但这里有新的修改，已为你保留。保存即确认恢复这个条: This item was deleted on another device, but it has newer changes here, so Keevo kept it. Saving confirms that you want to keep it.
这个条目在回收站中。: This item is in Recently Deleted.
这个条目的并发修订异常多。编辑并保存一次即可合并。: This item has an unusual number of concurrent revisions. Edit and save it once to merge them.
这个构建无法连接浏览器（需要打包后的 Keevo.app）。可以稍后在「设置 →: This build can't connect to browsers (it needs the packaged Keevo.app). You can connect later in Settings → Browser.
这个构建没有编译进 native host 的 cdhash，请用 script: This build doesn't include the native host's cdhash. Package it with scripts/package-macos.sh and run that.
这个构建没有编译进扩展 ID。: This build doesn't include the extension ID.
这个版本只有标题。: This version has only a title.
这个版本已超出保留期，只保留了修订记录。: This version is past the retention period; only its revision record remains.
这个版本的内容会作为一次新的修改保存；当前的内容仍然留在历史中，可以再恢复回来。: This version's content is saved as a new change. The current content stays in the history and can be restored later.
这个组合键已被其他应用占用，请换一个。: Another app is using this shortcut. Choose a different one.
这个网站支持一次性密码，你还没有保存。: This site supports one-time passwords, but you haven't saved one.
这个请求来自转发的 agent：一台远程主机正在使用你的密钥登录别处。除非你刚刚: This request comes through a forwarded agent: a remote host is using your key to log in elsewhere. Deny it unless you just ran ssh or git on that remote host.
这些密码出现在公开的泄露数据中，攻击者会优先尝试。请尽快在对应网站修改。: These passwords appear in public breach data, and attackers try them first. Change them on those sites soon.
这些网站支持一次性密码，你还没有保存: These sites support one-time passwords you haven't saved
这份备份属于另一个 Keevo 账户，不能用来恢复这个保险库。: This backup belongs to another Keevo account and can't be used to restore this vault.
这份备份来自更新版本的 Keevo，请先更新 Keevo。: This backup is from a newer version of Keevo. Update Keevo first.
这可能是你在别的设备上特意调高的，也可能是数据被人改过，目的是让解锁耗尽这台 M: You may have raised it on another device, or the data may have been altered to make unlocking exhaust this Mac's memory or time.
这台 Mac 上没有可用的账户密钥（例如数据是从别处恢复的）。请从应急包中输入账: There's no usable Secret Key on this Mac (for example, the data was restored from elsewhere). Enter the Secret Key from your Emergency Kit; after that only the master password is needed.
这台 Mac 上没有找到 Chrome。安装 Chrome 后，可以在「设置 →: Chrome isn't installed on this Mac. After installing it, connect in Settings → Browser.
这台 Mac 在这段时间内没有任何键盘、鼠标或触控板操作时锁定。: Locks when this Mac has had no keyboard, mouse, or trackpad activity for this long.
这台 Mac 没有可用的 Touch ID，或还没有登记指纹。: Touch ID isn't available on this Mac, or no fingerprints are enrolled.
这台 Mac 的 Secure Enclave 暂时不可用，Keevo 没有做任: The Secure Enclave on this Mac is temporarily unavailable. Keevo hasn't changed anything. Make sure the screen is unlocked, then try again.
这把密钥设置为每次使用都确认。可以在「设置 → 开发者」中修改。: This key asks every time it's used. You can change that in Settings → Developer.
这把私钥有口令保护。输入口令后导入：口令只用于这一次解密，不会保存。: This private key is protected by a passphrase. Enter it to import; it's used only for this decryption and isn't saved.
这是 Bitwarden 的「账户限制」加密导出，只能由原来的 Bitwarde: This is a Bitwarden “account restricted” encrypted export, which only the original Bitwarden account can decrypt. Export again as “password protected” in Bitwarden.
这是 Keevo 少数会主动发起的网络请求之一，可以随时关闭（docs/gove: This is one of the few network requests Keevo makes on its own, and you can turn it off anytime (docs/governance.md §5).
这是永久删除留下的记录，没有内容。: This record was left by a permanent deletion and has no content.
这是这个扩展第一次在这个网站上使用这个条目。允许后不再询问，可在「设置 → 浏览: This is the first time this extension uses this item on this website. Once allowed, Keevo won't ask again; you can revoke it in Settings → Browser. If you didn't click fill in the browser, or this isn't the website you're visiting, choose Deny.
选择存放 Keevo 备份的文件夹，例如外部硬盘或同步盘中的文件夹。: Choose a folder for Keevo backups, such as one on an external drive or in a synced folder.
通用格式，大多数密码管理器都能导入；只包含登录: A common format most password managers can import; logins only
遵守 macOS 窗口共享设置的截屏、录屏与屏幕共享软件看不到 Keevo，避免: Screenshot, recording, and screen-sharing apps that respect macOS window sharing can't see Keevo, so passwords don't show up by accident when you share your screen.
配置无效，请在编辑器中检查: Invalid setup. Check it in the editor
重复使用 · 这 {} 个条目使用同一个密码: Reused · these {} items share one password
附件与条目一起加密保存在这台 Mac 上；单个文件最大 50 MB。也可以把文件: Attachments are encrypted with the item and stored on this Mac, up to 50 MB per file. You can also drag files here.
附件保留在条目的历史版本中，可以通过「恢复到此版本」找回；清理历史后彻底删除。: The attachment stays in the item's history, so you can get it back with “Restore This Version”. It's deleted for good when the history is cleaned up.
